BrochureContent.Content:
Nestled within the popular and family-friendly Cul Ard development, 3 An Réileán is a well-maintained end-of-terrace residence presented in good condition throughout. Offering bright, spacious accommodation and a good size rear garden, this attractive home is ideally suited to first-time buyers, growing families, and those seeking a convenient commuter location with excellent local amenities.

The accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hallway, a comfortable living room, and a spacious kitchen with a dining area. Upstairs, there are three well-proportioned bedrooms (main ensuite), a family bathroom, and a landing area.

Externally, the property enjoys a generous rear garden providing excellent outdoor space for family enjoyment, entertaining, gardening, or future enhancement. A selection of garden sheds offers valuable additional storage.

Carrigtwohill is one of East Cork's most desirable residential locations, renowned for its strong community spirit, excellent schools, sporting clubs, shops, cafés, and everyday amenities. The area has become increasingly popular with families due to its welcoming atmosphere and excellent quality of life.

The property benefits from superb connectivity, with easy access to the N25, regular bus services, and Carrigtwohill Train Station, making commuting straightforward and convenient. Midleton is located just minutes away and offers an extensive range of shopping, dining, leisure, and educational facilities, while Cork City is approximately a 20-minute drive, making this an ideal location for those seeking the perfect balance between suburban living and city accessibility.

Further enhancing its appeal, the property boasts a BER B rating (BER No. 119520070), offering excellent energy efficiency and helping to reduce day-to-day running costs.

With its spacious accommodation, large rear garden, energy-efficient rating, and prime location close to Carrigtwohill, Midleton, and Cork City, 3 An Réileán presents an outstanding opportunity to acquire a quality family home.
